scope: Rejected private offscreen restoration candidate on USB iPad; candidate source removed, no production path changed

runs.name: active-pencil
runs.scenario: Resource pressure, release, active Pencil and raw rollback: correct window at 55.659 ms within 100 ms, contact preserved

runs.name: exact-journey
runs.scenario: Raw+authored first drag 120.367 ms, second 75.217 ms; cancel correct at 113.200 ms but one mixed window capture at 74.53 ms

decision: Reject and remove the candidate: GPU-complete offscreen material, bounded blit and one CATransaction did not remove the observed mixed window state and worsened first/cancel latency. A native window capture is not an OS photon receipt; physical screen recording was unavailable because CoreDevice reports Screen Recording unsupported on this device. No threshold changed.
